note: Measured virtual-array layout of the cascaded AWR2243 board, and the phase between its two chips per firmware variant. Read by perception/core/calibration.py; used by perception/radar.py (layout='measured', the default). Written by perception/estimate_array_layout.py. The team layout in perception/core/radar_config.py does not match the board (docs/knowledge/03_radar_firmware_and_dca.md, 'Off-axis azimuth').

layout.chirp_tx_pos_note: lambda/2, per chirp (chirp = loop * 6 + tx), within a chip's group; null = an elevated TX (chirps 3 and 4: their phase follows the target's elevation), not in the azimuth row. Measured relative to chirp 0: 0, -2, -4, (elevated), (elevated), +3.
layout.chip_offset_note: lambda/2 from the master chip's group (RX0-3) to the slave's (RX4-7). Each chip's group is 11 contiguous positions (0..10); the gap between them is 8.

elevated_chirps_approx.note: approximate, from the plate sessions; elevation is not computed from them yet

layout.measured: 2026-11-07, stage3_01-03 + freewalk_ref_02 (LiDAR azimuth); checked on calibration_dataset 2026-11-03 (camera azimuth)

r075m_v2_8fps.provisional: measured in situ (LiDAR azimuth); a corner-reflector measurement can replace it
